name: MLB Dodgers runs allowed per game (defense), 2024 daily
citation: MLB Dodgers runs allowed per game (defense), 2024 daily. Data obtained from Retrosheet 2024 game logs (gl2024.zip), www.retrosheet.org/gamelogs/. The information used here was obtained free of charge from and is copyrighted by Retrosheet. Interested parties may contact Retrosheet at www.retrosheet.org.

description: Per-game runs allowed by the 2024 Los Angeles Dodgers pitching/defense, with a covariate panel of the opponent's same-game batting outcomes (what the defense allowed). Application: run-prevention forecasting ("how many runs will we allow?"). Target = runs allowed.
preprocessing: 1. Per-game Dodgers 2024 box-score series extracted from Retrosheet game logs; one value per game.
2. Reshaped to TempusBench long format: one row per variable with columns variable_name, variable_unit, timestamps, values.
3. Games re-indexed to consecutive daily dates; timestamps emitted as ISO-8601 UTC strings (00:00:00Z), shared across all variables.

4. Variable and unit names written in plain English (spaces, no underscores); the target_ prefix dropped. No calendar/time-feature covariates are included — the only notion of time is the shared timestamps list.
5. runs allowed (target, runs): Runs allowed by the Dodgers (per game)
6. hits allowed (covariate, hits): Hits allowed by Dodgers pitching (per game)
7. home runs allowed (covariate, home runs): Home runs allowed by Dodgers pitching (per game)
8. walks allowed (covariate, walks): Walks allowed by Dodgers pitching (per game)
9. strikeouts pitched (covariate, strikeouts): Strikeouts recorded by Dodgers pitching (per game)
